sentences.text: This Court has taken consistent view in the matters of acquisition of lands from cluster of villages for 'Nimna Dudhana' project.

After considering all aspects of the matter, rate of Rs.2,500/- per Are for Jirayat land, Rs.3,750/- per Are for Semi irrigated land, Rs.5,000/- for per Are irrigated land and Rs.1,250/- per Are for pot kharab land have been arrived at.
The benefit of escalation has also been granted in numerous cases.
Present case is squarely covered by one such common judgment of Pralhad Annasaheb Nirwal (supra).
The appellants are entitled to receive rate of Rs. 3750/- per Are for semi-irrigated land and Rs. 1250/- per Are for pot-kharab land, and escalation at the rate of Rs. 10% per annum.
Thus the appellants are entitled to receive compensation of Rs. 6639/- per Are for semi-irrigated land and Rs. 2213/- per Are for pot-kharab.
The payment of interest shall be governed by the decision of full bench in State of Maharashtra Vs. Kailash Shiva Rangari [2016 AIR (Bom.)141].

d. The appellants shall be entitled to the interest under Section 28 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as per full bench judgment of State of Maharashtra Vs. Kailash Shiva Rangari [2016 AIR (Bom.)141].
